name: MCP HTTP Relay
description: Relay to a customer-hosted MCP server over Streamable HTTP or SSE using organization credentials.
use_cases: Connect a hosted MCP (Streamable HTTP / SSE) so Studio and discovery can test and list resources
Org-scoped credentials for generic MCP servers that are not first-party SaaS connectors
Discovery --apply target for unmatched HTTP/SSE MCPs (loxtep-sdk mcp-http)

entity.name: MCP HTTP Relay
entity.description: Speak MCP to a remote URL with Loxtep-stored credentials. Distinct from Loxtep’s outbound hosted MCP server.

mcp_url.help: Required. MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint or SSE URL.

transport.help: http | sse | auto (default auto: try Streamable HTTP, fall back to SSE).

auth_type.help: none | api_key | bearer | oauth2. Credentials stored in Loxtep only — never copy IDE vault tokens by default.

headers.help: Optional extra headers as JSON object or key: value lines.

resource_allowlist.help: Optional JSON array of MCP resource URIs to expose as entities.

tool_allowlist.help: Optional JSON array of read-shaped tool names used when the server has no resources.

connection_config_spec.help: mcp_url + auth in custom_settings / connector secrets. Runtime uses platform native McpHttpConnector.

mcp_url.description: Hosted MCP Streamable HTTP or SSE URL

auth_type.description: Auth scheme for the remote MCP

connector_package.description: Org-scoped MCP relay. Speaks MCP tools/list, resources/list, and resources/read against a customer URL. Not rest-api and not the Loxtep outbound MCP server.
follow_up_notes: Connect ≠ ingest: test and entity discovery only until a Products workflow is authorized.
Do not map generic MCP to rest-api.
Stdio MCP is out of scope for this connector type.
Relay vs first-party: first-party SaaS maps (Shopify, GitHub, …) stay dedicated types; mcp-http is for unmatched hosted HTTP/SSE MCPs.
Relay vs action-only: write-only toolsets should stay action_only in discovery, not Connect ingest connectors.
